caption: The drawing displays four rectangular fabric samples arranged in a grid pattern on a plain, off-white background. The top fabric features a geometric checkerboard design in beige and blue, consisting of alternating solid beige squares and blue squares with beige geometric patterns and zigzag lines. Below, there are two side-by-side fabric samples: the left sample has a brown background adorned with small floral motifs in red, yellow, and blue, along with green stems and leaves; the right sample has a similar brown background with a dense arrangement of small multicolored flowers, primarily red, yellow, orange, and blue, along with green leaves. At the bottom is a fourth fabric sample featuring an interlocking hexagonal pattern in blue, gold, and beige, forming a honeycomb-like design. The name "Albert Levone" is written in small text below the lowest fabric sample.
title: Cloth Samples
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
